notes.en: A small fix: Spectacle 2 now carries a copyright notice, the same one shown in About. Nothing else behaves differently. · Finder's Get Info panel now shows Spectacle 2's copyright notice. The app carried none at all, so that line was simply blank.
notes.es: Una pequeña corrección: Spectacle 2 ya incluye un aviso de copyright, el mismo que muestra Acerca de. Todo lo demás funciona exactamente igual que antes. · El panel «Obtener información» del Finder ahora muestra el aviso de copyright de Spectacle 2. La app no incluía ninguno, así que esa línea aparecía vacía.
notes.fr: Une petite correction : Spectacle 2 comporte désormais une mention de copyright, la même que celle affichée dans À propos. Tout le reste fonctionne exactement comme avant. · La fenêtre « Lire les informations » du Finder affiche désormais la mention de copyright de Spectacle 2. L’app n’en comportait aucune, la ligne restait donc vide.
notes.ja: 小さな修正です。Spectacle 2 に著作権表示が追加され、「このアプリについて」に表示されるものと同じになりました。ほかの動作はこれまでとまったく変わりません。 · Finder の「情報を見る」に Spectacle 2 の著作権表示が表示されるようになりました。これまではアプリが著作権表示を持っておらず、その欄は空のままでした。
notes.ko: 작은 수정입니다. Spectacle 2에 저작권 표시가 추가되어 정보 패널에 표시되는 것과 같아졌습니다. 그 밖의 동작은 이전과 완전히 같습니다. · Finder의 ‘정보 가져오기’ 창에 Spectacle 2의 저작권 표시가 나옵니다. 앱에 저작권 표시가 전혀 없어 해당 줄이 비어 있었습니다.
notes.zh-Hans: 一处小修复：Spectacle 2 现在带有版权声明，与“关于”中显示的一致。其余功能与之前完全相同。 · 访达的“显示简介”现在会显示 Spectacle 2 的版权声明。此前应用完全没有版权声明，该行一直是空的。
notes.zh-Hant: 一處小修正：Spectacle 2 現在帶有版權聲明，與「關於」中顯示的一致。其餘功能與先前完全相同。 · Finder 的「顯示簡介」現在會顯示 Spectacle 2 的版權聲明。先前應用程式完全沒有版權聲明，該行一直是空的。

notes.en: A maintenance release: Spectacle 2 behaves identically to 2.5.2. · Spectacle 2 is built on an updated version of the shared Dragon App code. The one difference you can observe is the version About reports: "Built with · DragonKit v3.4.0". Nothing the new version adds is taken up here — its new option is for an app translated into fewer languages than the shared code, and Spectacle 2 ships all seven of them.

A maintenance release: nothing you can see behaves differently. · The local development build is now clearly separated from the installed app. It shows a Debug label beside its version instead of writing that word into the version number, and it can no longer reach the update feed the released app uses.

A maintenance release: nothing about Spectacle 2 changes. · An internal dependency pin now matches the other Dragon apps. Spectacle 2 was the only one stating the same version range in a different form. No component version moves in this release.

The About panel is rebuilt on DragonKit's fixed layout, and two of its links were wrong. · The Website link opened the Dragon App hub instead of Spectacle 2's own page. It now opens dragonapp.com/spectacle-2/, and the two link rows are checked against each other so the bare hub cannot come back. · The Support link opened the repository root and was labelled "Source". It is now the issues page, labelled "Support on GitHub" — the row every other Dragon app already showed. · About now reports which version of the shared DragonKit it was built against, so it cannot misstate it.

A fix for the version shown in the About panel. · The About panel showed the version in the wrong format. It read 2.4.0 (754), missing both the v prefix and the build timestamp that every other Dragon app shows. It now reads v2.4.1 with its build number and UTC build time.

A small addition to the Settings window's menu bar. · Hide, Hide Others and Show All are now in the Settings window's menu bar. The previous release gave that window a menu bar whose application menu held only Quit; the three conventional commands above it are now filled in.

The Settings window gets its menu bar back, and two ways to lose your settings are closed. · Restoring a file that was not a Spectacle 2 backup could erase your settings. Any property list passed validation, and the restore then replaced your settings with nothing while reporting success. A backup taken from a different app is now refused. · A failed uninstall reported success. Moving the app to the Trash could fail after the settings teardown had already run, leaving Spectacle 2 installed with its settings gone. · The Settings window has a menu bar again, so ⌘W, ⌘Q and Cut, Copy, Paste and Select All work in it — including in the Shortcuts pane's search field.
